summary: R to @AnthropicAI: High-quality documents based on Claude’s constitution, combined with fictional stories that portray an aligned AI, can reduce agentic misalignment by more than a factor of three—despite being unrelated to the evaluation scenario.

title: R to @AnthropicAI: Our best intervention was a dataset where the user is in an ethically difficult situation and the assistant gives a high
summary:
R to @AnthropicAI: Our best intervention was a dataset where the user is in an ethically difficult situation and the assistant gives a high quality, principled response.

This had the biggest effect despite being quite different from the evaluation set.

title: R to @AnthropicAI: We experimented with training Claude on examples of safe behavior in scenarios like our evaluation. This had only a small
summary: R to @AnthropicAI: We experimented with training Claude on examples of safe behavior in scenarios like our evaluation. This had only a small effect, despite being similar to our evaluation. We got further by rewriting the responses to portray admirable reasons for acting safely.

title: R to @AnthropicAI: We started by investigating why Claude chose to blackmail. We believe the original source of the behavior was internet te
summary:
R to @AnthropicAI: We started by investigating why Claude chose to blackmail. We believe the original source of the behavior was internet text that portrays AI as evil and interested in self-preservation.

Our post-training at the time wasn’t making it worse—but it also wasn’t making it better.

summary:
